Entries with 'DRAFT' in notes were filled by fetch.py (carried or generic) because no researched entry existed. Formats: single_elim, double_elim, pods (groups play double-elim or round robin, winners to single elim), pool_play, series (best-of-3 between top 2), none (regular-season champion gets the bid).

MEAC.description: Top six in the regular-season standings, double elimination at Norfolk State; seeds 1-2 bye (3v6, 4v5 open); winners'-bracket team needs one win in the final, if-necessary second game.
MEAC.notes: No. 5 NCCU opened vs No. 4 Morgan State; if-necessary carried from 2023.

Mid-American.description: Top 6, double elimination at Firestone Stadium, Akron; seeds 1-2 bye (4v5, 3v6 open); if-necessary game.
Mid-American.notes: Schedule lists championship game plus 'if necessary' game.

Missouri Valley.description: All 12 teams, single elimination: seeds 5-12 play an opening round, seeds 1-4 enter the quarterfinals; single-game final.
Missouri Valley.notes: At Drake (Des Moines); 12-team bracket with 5-12 opening round confirmed; single elimination assumed from identical 2023-24 structure.

Mountain West.description: Six teams; seeds 3-6 play single-elimination games, winners join top two seeds (Nevada, SDSU) in a 4-team double-elimination bracket with an if-necessary final.

NEC.description: Top four regular-season finishers in a 4-team double-elimination tournament.
NEC.notes: LIU top seed, CCSU fourth seed; May 8-10 in Brooklyn.

Ohio Valley.description: Eight teams; seeds 5-8 play single-elimination play-in games, winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket where seeds 1-2 get an extra (double) bye.
Ohio Valley.notes: Same structure as 2026. If-necessary final assumed from standard DE.

Patriot League.description: Top four regular-season finishers in a 4-team double-elimination tournament.
Patriot League.notes: Army (1), BU (2), Lehigh (3), Bucknell (4) at West Point; three-day double elimination.

SEC.description: First 15-team SEC tournament (Oklahoma and Texas added). Seeds 10-15 play the first round, seeds 5-9 have one bye, seeds 1-4 have two byes. The final was cancelled for weather (see notes).

SWAC.description: Top four from each division (8 teams) at Gulfport, double elimination; game 15 if necessary.

Southern.description: All 8 teams; seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination opening round, winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket.

Southland.description: Top 8 split into two 4-team double-elimination brackets at the 1 and 2 seeds' fields; bracket winners play a best-of-3 championship series at the higher remaining seed.
Southland.notes: 2025 final went three games (Southeastern Louisiana over McNeese).

Summit League.description: Top 6: seeds 3-6 play a single-elimination first round, then double elimination with seeds 1-2.

Sun Belt.description: Ten-team single elimination at Troy (nine games); seeds 1-6 bye to quarterfinals, 7-10 play first round.

West Coast.description: No conference tournament; the regular-season champion (with tiebreakers) received the automatic bid.
West Coast.notes: WCC announced June 2025 a 4-team double-elimination softball tournament starting in 2026-27 (i.e. spring 2027).

Western Athletic.description: Eight teams at Riverside: single-elimination play-ins for seeds 5-8, then double elimination; 'if necessary' game 13 scheduled for the final.
Western Athletic.notes: Play-in structure inferred from game-13 count and 2022-24 format.

ACC.description: Top 12 of 15 softball members; top four seeds get byes into the quarterfinals, seeds 5-12 play the first round.

ASUN.description: Top 8 of 12; seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination opening round, the two winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket.

America East.description: All five remaining America East softball teams; regular-season winner gets a single bye, others play opening-round games; double elimination.

American.description: All 10 teams, single-elimination stepladder: seeds 7-10 open, seeds 5-6 enter round 2, seeds 3-4 enter the quarterfinals, seeds 1-2 get byes to the semifinals.
American.notes: byes counts seeds 1-6 skipping the opening round; seeds 3-4 skip two rounds and 1-2 skip three.

Atlantic 10.description: Top 6 of 9; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Big 12.description: Top 8 of 11 teams in an 8-team single-elimination bracket with no byes (quarterfinals, semifinals, final). Arizona State won as the 6 seed.

Big East.description: Back to the top four teams in a 4-team double-elimination bracket.

Big Sky.description: All six Big Sky softball teams; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Big South.description: Top 5 of 7; regular-season winner gets a bye, double elimination.

Big Ten.description: Top 12 teams; seeds 5-12 play the first round, top four seeds get byes into the quarterfinals.

Big West.description: Top 6 of 10; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Coastal Athletic.description: Top 6 of 11; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Conference USA.description: Top 8 of 12; seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination opening round, winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket.

Horizon League.description: 6-team double elimination; seeds 1-2 bye into the second round (4v5, 3v6 open); championship can require an if-necessary game.
Horizon League.notes: Host = No. 1 Youngstown State; 4v5 and 3v6 opened. Final format assumed if-necessary per 2024 practice.

Ivy League.description: Top four teams, 4-team double elimination at the regular-season champion's site.

MAAC.description: Top 6 of 13; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.
MAAC.notes: Conference renamed Metro Conference from July 1, 2026.

MEAC.description: Top 6 of 8; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Mid-American.description: Top 6 of 12; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Missouri Valley.description: Top 6 of 8; 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.

Mountain West.description: Top 6 of 12; seeds 3-6 play a single-elimination play-in round, winners join seeds 1-2 in a 4-team double-elimination bracket.

NEC.description: Top four teams in a 4-team double-elimination bracket.

Ohio Valley.description: Top 8 of 10; seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination play-in, winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket in which seeds 1-2 get a further bye.

Patriot League.description: Top four teams in a 4-team double-elimination bracket.

SEC.description: All 15 teams; seeds 10-15 play the first round, seeds 5-9 enter in the second round, seeds 1-4 enter in the quarterfinals. Single-game final (Texas beat Alabama).

SWAC.description: Top four from each division in an 8-team double-elimination bracket.

Southern.description: All 8 teams; seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination play-in, winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket with seeds 1-2 getting a further bye; final has an if-necessary game.

Southland.description: Top 8 split into two 4-team double-elimination brackets at the 1 and 2 seeds' fields; bracket winners play a best-of-3 championship series at the higher remaining seed.

Summit League.description: Top 6: seeds 3-6 play a single-elimination first round, then double elimination with seeds 1-2.

Sun Belt.description: Top 10 of 12, single elimination; seeds 1-6 get byes to the quarterfinals, seeds 7-10 play opening-round games.

West Coast.description: No conference tournament; the regular-season champion (with tiebreakers) received the automatic bid.
West Coast.notes: WCC announced June 2025 a 4-team double-elimination softball tournament starting in 2026-27 (i.e. spring 2027).

Western Athletic.description: 6-team double elimination; top two seeds get a first-round bye, seeds 3-6 play opening-round games.
Western Athletic.notes: Last tournament under the WAC name; became the United Athletic Conference July 1, 2026.
